projects.name: Pet Palace
projects.description: A full-stack web application that allows pet owners to find, book, and review pet-friendly accommodations. Built with a modern tech stack to ensure a smooth and responsive user experience.

projects.name: Calendary
projects.description: A calendar and scheduling application built with the MERN stack, allowing users to manage their events efficiently with an intuitive interface and modern UI styling.

projects.name: Heroes App
projects.description: An interactive web app that provides information about different superheroes. Users can search for heroes, view their details, and explore their backgrounds in an engaging UI.

projects.name: Countries App
projects.description: A full-stack web application that allows users to explore information about different countries, including population, geography, and official languages, using data from an external API.

projects.name: Gif App
projects.description: A React-based web application that allows users to search for GIFs using the Giphy API. Features a sleek and responsive UI for an enjoyable browsing experience.

projects.name: To Do App
projects.description: A simple and intuitive To-Do application that helps users manage tasks efficiently. Built with React, featuring task creation, deletion, and completion functionalities.

projects.name: Rick and Morty App
projects.description: A fun web application that lets users explore characters from the Rick and Morty universe. Users can search, filter, and view character details with a smooth and interactive UI.
